set.body:
Outcome

Prove the replacement architecture with generated laws, independent oracles, strict cross-platform gates, work and allocation evidence, clean consumers, and final clean-worktree verification.

Acceptance

- All architecture and method gates are green on JVM and Scala.js.
- Optimized Scala.js, performance, fixture freshness, and consumer courts pass.
- No legacy vocabulary remains.
- A requirement-by-requirement completion audit is recorded before the epic closes.
set.title: P7: establish the final law, performance, consumer, and release court
